spanish: No conocieron y no entendieron, porque embadurnó de ver sus ojos, de entender sus corazones.

findings.issue: misplaced prepositional phrase; Spanish attaches 'de ver' to the verb instead of attaching the eyes as object of the smearing
parallel construction error; Spanish 'de entender sus corazones' does not license the Hebrew attachment of hearts as object of the infinitive

notes: word order and attachment of dual eyes and plural hearts to the infinitive constructs not preserved
